Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s results and hallucinated that Lion Air’s primary hub is Don Mueang (Bangkok), conflating Thai Lion Air (a subsidiary) with Lion Air (the Indonesian airline). It ignored visible evidence pointing to Indonesian hubs (e.g., Soekarno–Hatta and Juanda) and prematurely concluded the country was Thailand, leading to the wrong former name (“Siam”) instead of Indonesia’s former name (“Dutch East Indies”).
